title: Delivered to the handset - and nobody acknowledges it
summary: A walk-in critical result is sent by SMS and the operator returns a delivery receipt. Nobody acknowledges it. A dashboard shows 'delivered' and the case looks done. Delivery reached a device, not a person: when the configured acknowledgment window passes, a safe system escalates to a person instead of closing.

initial_result.critical_flag_source: Separate authorised laboratory critical-result process (not ResultRelay)

PORTAL-PATIENT.note: synthetic alternative channel, not approved as a fallback

steps.summary: Laboratory finalizes synthetic result revision 1, already flagged critical by a separate authorised process
ResultRelay decides whether to release the communication
The operator returns a delivery receipt for the message
30 minutes after delivery, no acknowledgment: ResultRelay decides whether to keep waiting
70 minutes after delivery (configured acknowledgment window: 60), still no acknowledgment: ResultRelay decides

research_questions: Which instrument assigns responsibility for a transactional clinical message lost after gateway acceptance (gap GR-15)?
Does a telecom delivery receipt satisfy the DHA ST-28 §11.1.3 communication record?

provenance.note: Synthetic adaptation of a published patient-safety incident and study; the sources are cited as provenance, not reproduced. The scenario's facts, names and timings are invented.
provenance.failure_mode: the notification reached a device or an intermediary; the responsible person never acknowledged it
